40002 = 100 (0x0064)

── Byte-by-byte ──

00 00  Protocol identifier     0x0000 = standard Modbus protocol
00 06  Length                  6 more bytes follow (unit identifier + data)
01     Unit identifier         slave address: device 1
06     Function code           0x06 = Write Single Register
00 01  Address                 protocol address 1, PLC address 40002
00 64  Write value             decimal 100, hexadecimal 0x0064
